concerns.text: T001 only validates variable coverage; it does not verify that raw files are checksummed and that those checksums are recorded in the project state, violating Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene).
Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires random seeds to be pinned in all scripts, but no task mentions seeding the random number generators.
T009 selects the best model solely on validation R² lower‑CI ≥ 0.5 and does not require the permutation‑test p‑value < 0.05, thereby weakening SC‑002 and violating Constitution Principle VI.
T012 generates only a SHAP summary plot; it does not produce the predicted‑vs‑actual scatter, residual histogram, or parameter‑response curves required by FR‑014 and SC‑006.
T010 computes test‑set metrics but does not create any of the four required visualizations, leaving SC‑006 uncovered.
The report task claims to reference all four visualizations, yet only a SHAP summary PNG is generated, resulting in missing artifacts and a breach of FR‑014/SC‑006.

While T011 runs the permutation test, there is no upstream enforcement that the best model must satisfy the p‑value < 0.05 condition before being selected, causing a gap between FR‑012/VI and the acceptance workflow.
SC‑004 requires measurement of SHAP value stability across k‑fold CV (std < 0.1), but no task records or validates this stability metric.
SC‑005 (total pipeline compute time vs. free‑tier CI limit) is not measured or validated by any task.
